title: Re-resolve instances after template edits
description: Make shared-template edits update all referencing instances while preserving compatible data and intentional overrides and diagnosing any newly invalid assignment fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing a shared template changes subsequent resolution for every reference without rewriting assignment records
Compatible per-label values and allow-listed overrides remain attached to their stable input and node identities
Removed, renamed, retyped, or newly constrained inputs produce assignment- and input-specific diagnostics
Invalid overrides identify the assignment, target node, property, and incompatibility
No invalid instance is silently reset, coerced, flattened, or included in PDF preparation

steps.details: Compare each assignment's stored input and override identities with the edited template definitions and rich node tree using pure validation.
Retain values and overrides whose stable targets and constraints remain compatible, without copying resolved template content back into assignments.
Emit deterministic assignment/input/node/property diagnostics for removed or incompatible targets and block only invalid generation paths.
Edit one template referenced twice and assert both update, distinct values remain, compatible overrides persist, and invalidated data is visible and refused.

technicalNotes: Keep this task within ten minutes by handling one edit/resolution cycle with focused compatibility fixtures.
Do not auto-delete invalid data; preserving it allows user repair and audit.
